verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a self-hosting deployment path via Docker Compose and mention SSO/auth setup, indicating an official self-host install route exists, but the evidence never shows the actual one-line install command, a single docker run/npm/pip install snippet, or any confirmation that a working chat is reachable in minutes. No independent/hands-on corroboration of install speed or simplicity is present either. missing for 10: exact one-command install snippet (docker run/compose one-liner or npm/pip command), time-to-first-chat evidence, independent user corroboration of quick setup.
